title: Pulsar N160 Dual Channel ABS (Track Edition)
description: Representing Bajaj Auto's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Bajaj Auto Pulsar N160 Dual Channel ABS (Track Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 160cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
